If you live in the country of those states much less chance you'll face mobs or rioters but you could loose utilities and no electricity means none to run gas or diesel pumps so have a supply on hand and rotate it, use what you store after a month keeping your stored gas and/or diesel fresh. How best to prep, I'm no expert, I just use common sense, think about what you won't be able to get, make a list, that's what you'll need. There are lots of prepper websites I guess you could look at. I keep at least two weeks of food for each family member, you can buy freeze dried emergency food supplies but I like to buy canned and dried foods, just like with gasoline we rotate the stored food into our weekly grocery's and replace what we take out of the stored supply to keep it fresh. We also vac-n-seal food in the fall for the freezer but the vac-n-seal also make it handy to make dried stored supplies last longer. I could fish, trap and hunt if need be to supplement food supplies. I would start with food then expand other supplies over time, you should keep in mind if a emergency came up during the winter you'll need a way to stay warm too. We keep propane for heaters and cooking, also a small wood stove, we have rain barrels and a creek within walking distance for other water sources. I keep filtering water pitchers with extra filters, inexpensive and they work. We have a couple deep cycle battery's from the boat, I added a solar panel to recharge them and a couple 110 volt converters, you could always get a generator. I have inexpensive hand held two way radios that run on cb & ham radio frequencies for backup communications, and small battery's, AA, AAA, 9V, C's D's, lots of them!! (again, rotate them to keep them fresh) Also need to think about meds if anyone in the family takes them for medical issues, you'll need a supply, talk to your doctor about that. Emergency medical supplies and a good medical treatment book. Basically, anything and everything to be self sufficient for at least a couple weeks. If you live in a big city, I don't know what life like that is like but I'd make bug out bags, one for each member and make plans of how to get out of the city with alternate routes in case one is blocked and you'll need a place where you could go to, you'll need cash too. That's idea's off the top of my head, you can expand from there, sky is the limit if your pockets are deep enough. But for me, 95% of my supplies are rotated into our normal use to keep supplies fresh and also so it's never money that will end up being wasted. I'm sure other's will have good idea's as well.
